title: Gatekeeper Rego input document
description: The `input` the gatekeeper evaluates every policy package against, built only after the evidence bundle passed cryptographic verification. See docs/contracts/rego-input.md.

verified.description: Always true: Rego never runs on unverified evidence.

channelBinding.description: The gatekeeper always binds to the live TLS leaf it observed.

root.description: Name of the root the chain terminated in: a trustedRoots[].name, or `attested:<mrEnclave>` for a root accepted on its own TEE evidence (see rootAttestation).

rootAttestation.description: Present only when the chain's terminal root was checked against its own TEE evidence, which happens when the manual trustedRoots list did not match it. Absent for a root the user pinned, so a policy can require one or the other.

attested.description: Whether the root was accepted on its evidence. False here means the verdict came from somewhere else, or was a denial.

evidenceType.description: Hardware the certificate authority enrolled from, e.g. "AMD SEV-SNP (QEMU)".

networkType.description: The network the root certificate declares. Reported, not enforced, unless attestedRoots.requireNetworkType says otherwise.

measurement.description: Normalised mrEnclave of the certificate authority's VM, in hex.

inRegistry.description: Whether Super Protocol has signed that measurement.

reportIntegrity.description: Whether the hardware report's signature and its chain to the CPU vendor's root verified.

revocationChecked.description: Whether the vendor CRLs were consulted. False means they were not, never that the chain is clean.

notRevoked.description: Result of that check, meaningful only when revocationChecked is true.

keyBinding.description: Whether the report's reportData commits to this certificate's public key.

cpuGeneration.description: CPU line the verified vendor chain belongs to, e.g. "Genoa".

teeFlags.description: Report fields describing how the VM was allowed to run. Reported as read: which combination is acceptable is what this policy is for.

evidence.description: The verified DeploymentEvidence JWS payload plus convenience fields. Unknown payload fields are passed through.

evidenceDigest.description: Normalised to canonical sha256/<base64url> before evaluation.

evidence.description: Canonical deployment snapshot as published (opaque; version 2 = { version, resources[] }).

containerImages.description: Every string `image` field found in the snapshot, flattened and deduplicated.

fingerprint.description: sha256/<base64url, unpadded> of DER bytes or of the canonical JSON.
